correctness.rationale: For I>0 the stationary V and S equations solve uniquely with V/S=sigma/(epsilon I+eta+mu+alpha_2 g(qI)), q=varphi/omega. The return term in the susceptible denominator is strictly less than sigma, so that denominator is positive. All other coordinates reconstruct positively and only the exposed balance remains. With h=alpha^[-1/(n-1)] and I=hy, the apparent singularity alpha g(qI)/I cancels and the extended equation at h=0 is S_0 q^n y^(n-1)/kappa-K(1-R_c), strictly increasing at its positive root. With t=1/alpha and I away from zero the equation extends smoothly with limit Lambda/I-K, whose derivative at Lambda/K is nonzero. Both implicit-function arguments therefore give roots for every sufficiently large alpha; their limits separate them. As a separate check, adding the stationary S,E,V balances gives K I=Lambda-mu S-(p eta+mu)V, confirming the large-root limit is approached from below. At the disease-free state g'(0)=0. The infected (E,I) and uninfected (S,V) blocks have negative traces and positive determinants xi K(1-R_c) and mu(sigma+eta+mu)+p eta sigma; the other eigenvalues are -mu and -omega. The exact rational witness was independently reconstructed. Its Q has signs (-,+,+,-) at (1/20,1/10,1/3,1) and a positive denominator. The numerator Sturm variations are 3 at 0 and 1 at positive infinity, giving exactly two positive roots, one in each interval. It gives R_c=5/42, sqrt(37)/4 and 2/3 as stated.
residual_risks: Exactly two positive roots is certified only for the rational witness. Neither generic endemic stability nor an exact bifurcation threshold follows. All rates other than alpha, including alpha_2, are fixed.

value.rationale: This model-specific result identifies a concrete limitation of relying on the disease-free invasion threshold or the local transcritical direction to rule out other equilibria. It proves persistence of two separate equilibrium branches as a parameter varies, distinguishes their scales quantitatively, and supplies a certified finite witness. It is not a claim about two attracting endemic states, public-health forecasts, or feasibility of the high-strength regime.
residual_risks: Endemic stability, basin structure, empirical parameter relevance and global trajectory behavior are not established.
